Hello, thanks for your report.
Would you be able to provide us with more information on this issue? In particular, we are interested in these bits of info:
- Step-by-step instructions to reproduce the problem
- Screenshots
- Video
- Any other relevant information
Treat the issue as if you're trying to show us how to make it happen. If we can cause the bug to occur, on our end, it makes it a ton easier to fix. If that isn't possible, documenting what it looks like when the bug happens might help.

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: Hi Tupper. There is no need to do anything it hapens from start and I also asked some people they have this issue too.
i made a video where I'm pointing up everytime its happening. I just start the game and spawn at home world
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1cmvYlb-98s5IxeoSVMWKsCD-y31R_2O7/view?usp=sharing

I experienced this at "Test Pilots" world at chopper landing.
It feels like "wind shear" or "turbulence"!

*visit https://en.vrcw.net/world/detail/wrld_e4908cea-023b-4749-9ad7-a898b12996e7
*launch chopper

*about every 10 minutes, you can feel it!
Environment:
Oculus Quest 2
quest_2021.3.3p1-6c988150**
(** is alphabet 2 characters)
VRCHAT:Build 1129
>Any other relevant information:
My friend in Japan also reported same at playing youtube on this assets.
https://booth.pm/ja/items/2758684

https://en.vrcw.net/world/detail/wrld_16c5f058-0462-4d5d-b1c5-bda0b50a870b

And if you want more information about this, send friend to me in vrchat world or respond.
Good day!
Yes. For me It's every 7-10 seconds, no matter what world, or avatar I'm in.  For about a quarter of a second there's this big lag spike.
@{5dfce8e12279e03dd45cfda1|full_name}: Have you found a solution for this? I’m having the same issue and it started two-three days ago.

@{612b0130f555ef27c92b5347|full_name}: Hi JawsCause.
Try "NEW INSTANCE" many time, whenever you don't recognize.
And endure...
Hope this glitch are gone!
@{6129a2b189319d25e7a9d0f6|full_name}: This doesn’t work. It doesn’t matter if I restart, go into new worlds, nothing works. It happens 24/7 endlessly.
@{6129fa3de75acc480198aa44|full_name}: did you find a solution to this?

@{612b0130f555ef27c92b5347|full_name}: No. For a moment I thought it was gone last night but I got on again tonight and it's still there. It's very distracting. Especially in games that involve timing. I'm kind of depressed tonight. Sorry.
@{6129fa3de75acc480198aa44|full_name}: Dont worry! I’ve contacted support and I’ll let you know what they say! Perhaps they have a solution for this.
@{612b0130f555ef27c92b5347|full_name}: lol Thanks, appreciate it. I thought this "was" support.

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: Hi Tupper.
I've confirmed that no matter what avatar you wear and what world you are in, small freeze occurs once every 10 seconds, so I think that it is reproducible under all conditions. (Even if it's the default robot avatar in VRChat Home.)
I'd also like to add a new piece of information: this problem only occurs in Quest2, not in Quest1.
Therefore, it is highly unlikely that it is due to low CPU performance, suggesting other complex causes.
This problem is making it difficult for Quest2 users to communicate and is resulting in an unpleasant user experience.
If you understand the importance of this issue, please help us investigate the cause!

I had this on but I turned it off but the problem still persisted I don't know maybe messing with refresh settings might work and I'll see what I can do in side quest as far as extra settings but I don't think there is going to be much to fix this.
